name: awesome-baremetal
desc: Bare-metal is awesome. Let's share our favourite tools.

resources.name: bmc-toolbox
resources.desc: "bmc-toolbox is bunch of tools to ease BMC management"

resources.name: cobbler
resources.desc: "Cobbler is a Linux installation server that allows for rapid setup of network installation environments"

resources.name: Collins
resources.desc: "CMDB / state machine for infrastructure automation"

resources.name: confluent
resources.desc: "Service for onboarding and management of baremetal server BMCs and PXE"

resources.name: foreman
resources.desc: "From provisioning and configuration to orchestration and monitoring, Foreman integrates with your existing infrastructure to make operations easier"

resources.name: LinuxKit
resources.desc: "A toolkit for building secure, portable and lean operating systems for containers" - PXE support, focus on immutable infrastructure.

resources.name: Typhoon
resources.desc: "A minimal and free Kubernetes distribution with Terraform backed by Fedora CoreOS or Flatcar Linux"

resources.name: MAAS
resources.desc: "Metal as a Service" by Canonical

resources.name: Matchbox
resources.desc: "Matchbox is a service that matches bare-metal machines to profiles that PXE boot and provision clusters"

resources.name: metalk8s
resources.desc: "MetalK8s was launched to make it easier to run Kubernetes (K8s) on bare-metal servers that need persistent storage" by Scality

resources.name: Metal Stack
resources.desc: "we believe kubernetes runs best on bare metal. we build an api to manage bare metal hardware and kubernetes on top of that."

resources.name: Metal³
resources.desc: "Bare Metal Host Provisioning for Kubernetes" - with ClusterAPI support and built with Ironic

resources.name: mr-provisioner
resources.desc: "Bare metal provisioning tool"

resources.name: netboot.xyz
resources.desc: "a way to PXE boot various operating system installers or utilities from one place within the BIOS without the need of having to go retrieve the media to run the tool."

resources.name: RackHD
resources.desc: "a technology stack for enabling automated hardware management and orchestration through cohesive APIs. It serves as an abstraction layer between other management layers and the underlying, vendor-specific physical hardware."

resources.name: Sidero Labs
resources.desc: (Formerly known as Talos Systems) "A New Tool for Kubernetes Bare Metal" - with ClusterAPI support

resources.name: Tinkerbell
resources.desc: "Tinkerbell is a bare metal provisioning engine. It’s built and maintained with love by the team at Equinix Metal."

resources.name: Warewulf
resources.desc: "Warewulf is a stateless and diskless container operating system provisioning system for large clusters of bare metal and/or virtual systems."

resources.name: dnsmasq
resources.desc: "Dnsmasq provides network infrastructure for small networks: DNS, DHCP, router advertisement and network boot."

resources.name: HAProxy
resources.desc: "The Reliable, High Performance TCP/HTTP Load Balancer" - often used in place of hardware LB.

resources.name: inlets
resources.desc: "A Cloud Native Tunnel for L4 TCP and L7 HTTPS" (sponsored)

resources.name: inlets-operator
resources.desc: "Public IPs for your private Kubernetes Services using inlets"

resources.name: kube-vip
resources.desc: "Kubernetes Control Plane Virtual IP and Load-Balancer"

resources.name: MetalLB
resources.desc: "MetalLB is a load-balancer implementation for bare metal Kubernetes clusters, using standard routing protocols."

resources.name: PorterLB
resources.desc: "PorterLB is an open-source load balancer implementation designed for bare-metal Kubernetes clusters."

resources.name: Squid
resources.desc: "a caching proxy for the Web supporting HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, and more. It reduces bandwidth and improves response times by caching and reusing frequently-requested web pages." - used with bare-metal to cache packages and ISO images

resources.desc: x86_64 only

resources.desc: x86_64 only

resources.name: QEMU
resources.desc: QEMU is the traditional hypervisor, which now contains a "microvm" profile

resources.name: oVirt
resources.desc: "oVirt is an open-source distributed virtualization solution, designed to manage your entire enterprise infrastructure. oVirt uses the trusted KVM hypervisor and is built upon several other community projects, including libvirt, Gluster, PatternFly, and Ansible."

resources.name: Ganeti
resources.desc: "Open source hyperconverged VM platform that scales from several to thousands of bare metal servers. Originally written for internal use at Google."

resources.name: Proxmox VE
resources.desc: "Proxmox VE is a complete open-source platform for all-inclusive enterprise virtualization that tightly integrates KVM hypervisor and LXC containers, software-defined storage and networking functionality on a single platform"

resources.name: actuated.dev
resources.desc: blazing fast CI for GitHub Actions using Firecracker (sponsored)

resources.name: OpenEBS
resources.desc: "Open Source Container Attached Storage, simplifies running Stateful Applications on Kubernetes.

resources.name: Rook
resources.desc: "Open-Source, Cloud-Native Storage Orchestrator for Kubernetes"

resources.name: SeaweedFS
resources.desc: Apache 2.0 - "SeaweedFS is a fast distributed storage system for blobs, objects, files, and data lake, for billions of files"

resources.name: Minio
resources.desc: AGPLv3 and commercial license for Object Storage.
